name: llm-wiki-dashboard
description: Reference dashboard for llm-wiki: what's new, what's running, what's scheduled, and the briefings. Fork it and make it yours.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
scripts.start:mock: npm run build -w client && cross-env DASHBOARD_SOURCE=fixtures npm run start -w server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
